topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon it, my words, precisely laid out on a site I never intended to grace. There it was, my application essay, in black and white, a public spectacle, an example for strangers to dissect. They didn't ask, of course. The university, or whoever decided my work should serve as a template, never reached out. It’s out there now, a part of me exposed without permission. I navigate the web carefully these days, wary of what else might surface, what other secrets might have been shared. I tell myself it’s a small world, a tiny breach, but the uncertainty looms, a shadow over my steps online.
